title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 001
review_goal: Recover the first 5 live MingCute audit blockers with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded padlock body with a closed shackle above a keyhole
items.context_bias: Use when a screen shows content or actions that are locked behind security or access control.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for general privacy policy text when the visible meaning is a locked or protected state.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot and official MingCute SVG both show a closed padlock with a centered keyhole.

items.depicts_observation: Bell outline with a diagonal slash crossing from upper left to lower right
items.context_bias: Use when alerts or notifications are muted disabled or intentionally turned off in the current surface.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for silent audio or generic disable actions when the visible object is specifically a bell.
items.selection_reason: The rendered screenshot clearly shows a bell with a visible off slash and matches the official source SVG.

items.depicts_observation: Front facing person bust with a small plus sign at upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface adds invites or creates a user profile account or member entry.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for follow social friend actions when the visible cue is a generic person plus control.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a centered person bust with a distinct plus badge at the upper right.

items.depicts_observation: Side profile person bust with a small plus sign at upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface adds or invites a person and the profile style matches a side facing user variant.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use interchangeably with the front facing user add icon when variant consistency matters in the product.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from user_add by showing a side profile bust while keeping the visible plus badge.

items.depicts_observation: Side profile person bust with a small x mark at lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface removes blocks or dismisses a user profile account or member entry.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for a generic close action when the visible form is a person symbol with an x badge.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot and official SVG show a side profile user with a distinct x badge instead of a plus.
